summary: This unit works out the late payment surcharge on one customer's bill: it returns zero if the bill has not been paid or was paid on or before the due date, and otherwise returns 10% of the energy amount.

rules.text: If the payment date is empty (the bill has not been paid), then the late payment surcharge is 0.
If the payment date is later than the due date, then the late payment surcharge is 10% of the energy amount, rounded to 2 decimal places.
If the payment date is on or before the due date, then the late payment surcharge is 0.
The late payment surcharge is not charged on bills paid on the due date itself, because only payments made after the due date trigger it.
